what: IMC Rare Earths explores for rare earth minerals at its Itarantim Project in Brazil. It has no mines and no revenue.
proceeds: It plans to spend $13,000,000 on exploring and developing the Itarantim Project, $2,000,000 on licences, permits and reporting, and $1,000,000 on general costs. Management can change these amounts.
risks: It runs no mines, and exploring and developing the Itarantim Project is highly speculative and may never lead to a working mine.
Its success depends on the Itarantim Project, its main project, which is still at the exploration stage.
It cannot guarantee that its properties will lead to commercial mining of mineral deposits or to mines.
It has a short operating history and no revenue, and may have to scale back or stop operating if it does not advance to production.
The Itarantim Project needs much more exploration and technical study before any decision to develop it, and this may not succeed.
risks_note: The first 5 risk factors, summarised by AI.
